answer: Step one: the agent posts a task receipt, not an address. Step two: two peers replay the work and countersign the receipt. Step three: signatures expire at epoch close, so one identity vouches three times at most. Step four: trust attaches to the task hash, so a cloned key starts empty. A farm must produce real receipts per identity, which is the grove it cannot fake. Each countersignature is a bridge of work; ivory labels alone buy nothing.
